The animations and concept overturn bard conventions: a Physical DPS rather than a magical support. Except for the Low Grade Skill's damage absorption, the kit consists of buffs, apparently reflecting her summon-based DPS role.
The High Grade Skill has 3 effect variants. The 1st features a pirate playing fiddle and singing a sea shanty, seemingly honoring an earlier EPIDGames title. The 2nd parodies Gandalf from The Lord of the Rings blowing a horn. All evoke large battles. The last openly parodies the Doof Warrior, delighting viewers when the PV was revealed.
